correctness.rationale: For every finite nonempty simple threshold graph and each integer k>=3, the three-variable vicinal-comparison formula defines a total preorder by isolated/universal vertex induction, and its equivalence classes are uniform twin blocks. Fixed-index block predicates can be nested using three reusable names; existential distinctness up to k and cross-edge tests recover the truncated ordered skeleton. The converse is an indefinite k-pebble back-and-forth: at most k-1 target vertices are occupied when a pebble moves; blocks of size >=k always have room, and smaller blocks have equal cardinalities. Truncation preserves strict block separation because original distinguishing vertices in a compared block remain available when its size>=2. The unique-minimal representative and sharp star K_{1,k} versus K_{1,k+1} follow. Source code check_vicinal.py and check_pebbles.py was inspected; finite tuple refinement of 127 creation words at k=3 and 31 at k=4 is supplementary, not the unbounded-depth proof.
